vedic_reference.note: Charulata is a beautiful Sanskrit name that means Charming and Graceful. It is derived from the Sanskrit words शुक्ल (shukla) meaning pure and चरुः (charuḥ) meaning form, grace, or beauty. The long meaning of the name is शुक्ल चरुः शरण्यं लाता, which translates to 'pure form of refuge or protection'.
